tools.name: mm_status
tools.description: Free status: environment, network, the paid offer and whether the paid tool is available. No secrets.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Use when you already have the URL of a specific public page and need its readable text — not for searching, crawling a site, or reaching anything behind a login. Fetches one public web page and returns it as clean markdown with its title, byline, language, word count and a SHA-256 of the output. Obe

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mm_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Free status: environment, network, the paid offer and whether the paid tool is available. No secrets.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "read_url" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch one public web page and return it as clean markdown with its title, byline, language, word count and a SHA-256 of the output. Obeys robots.txt; refuses private, internal and non-public addresses, oversized pages and content that is not HTML or plain text; never bypasses logins, paywalls or bot" → after: "Use when you already have the URL of a specific public page and need its readable text — not for searching, crawling a site, or reaching anything behind a login. Fetches one public web page and returns it as clean markdown with its title, byline, language, word count and a SHA-256 of the output. Obe"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
